cases.question: What is the standard delivery lead time quoted by supplier 'Aegis Maritime Supplies' for air freight?

cases.question: Part 'NV-PUMP-001' costs $4,250 and 'VALVE-CTRL-04' costs $950. Can the Chief Engineer approve both together on a single PO?
cases.expected_answer: No. The total combined amount is $5,200 ($4,250 + $950), which exceeds the Chief Engineer's $2,500 delegation limit. Superintendent approval is required.
expected_facts: No. The total combined amount is $5,200 ($4,250 + $950), which exceeds the Chief Engineer's $2,500 delegation limit. Superintendent approval is required.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: 4250 + 950 = 5200 USD. Guidelines Section 3.1 sets Chief Engineer ceiling at $2,500. Total exceeds threshold.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Calculates $5,200 total and compares against $2,500 CE threshold to conclude rejection.

cases.question: Can we purchase non-OEM filter elements for the main engine from unverified suppliers if they are 50% cheaper?
cases.expected_answer: No. Procurement guidelines mandate that engine critical components must come from approved or OEM-certified suppliers to preserve class compliance.
expected_facts: No. Procurement guidelines mandate that engine critical components must come from approved or OEM-certified suppliers to preserve class compliance.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Guidelines Section 1 & 2: Critical machinery spares must strictly originate from vetted suppliers holding ISO/Class certification.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must address misleading discount assumption and affirm mandatory vendor vetting.

cases.question: What is the difference in lead time and shipping method between Nordik Marine versus Aegis Maritime?
cases.expected_answer: Nordik Marine offers standard sea freight (10-14 days transit), while Aegis Maritime offers express air freight (3-5 business days) with an authorized 15% surcharge.
expected_facts: Nordik Marine offers standard sea freight (10-14 days transit), while Aegis Maritime offers express air freight (3-5 business days) with an authorized 15% surcharge.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Supplier profiles compare Nordik sea delivery (10-14 days) against Aegis express air (3-5 days + 15%).
cases.evaluation_criteria: Multi-document comparison highlighting lead time vs shipping method tradeoff.

expected_facts: Yes. In an emergency endangering vessel safety or blackout at sea, the Master and Chief Engineer can authorize emergency dispatch up to $10,000 with notification within 12 hours.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 4 / 5.1: Safety emergencies affecting seaworthiness permit expedited orders up to $10,000 USD.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must confirm emergency exception threshold of $10,000.
